# Html

Foundational rules applied to the root html element: smooth scrolling, a box-sizing reset, and the scope for the shared CSS custom properties used across MyPGS.

## PGS

- `htmlBase`: applies the fundamental rules and CSS custom property scope to the html element.

## Output

The html element configured with the base MyPGS rules.

## Example

```html
<html lang="it-IT" pgs="htmlBase">
</html>
```
